introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a secure monitoring platform for university servers and managed endpoints that collects system events, authentication activity, process information, and security alerts from multiple departments.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: The platform should detect unusual login behavior, repeated failed authentication, suspicious process activity, and unauthorized configuration changes.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: Security administrators should be able to review alerts, investigate affected devices, record investigation notes, change alert status, and isolate compromised endpoints when necessary.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: The system should maintain audit logs of security events and administrator actions and provide a centralized dashboard for monitoring security status across multiple campus locations.

functional.applicability_reason: Independent source obligations; unspecified choices remain TBD.

requirements.title: collect system events, authentication activity, process information, and security alerts from multiple departments for university servers and managed endpoints
requirements.statement: The system shall collect system events, authentication activity, process information, and security alerts from multiple departments for university servers and managed endpoints.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system collects system events, authentication activity, process information, and security alerts from multiple departments for university servers and mapped
acceptance_criteria.when: the system initiates the collection operation
acceptance_criteria.then: the requested input types are received by the system with no field-level representation or data structure specification
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: detect unusual login behavior
requirements.statement: The system shall detect unusual login behavior.

acceptance_criteria.given: system observes a login attempt with unusual timing and location
acceptance_criteria.then: the condition is identified and marked as anomalous in the monitoring state
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

unresolved_decisions: What conditions define unusual login behavior?

requirements.title: detect repeated failed authentication
requirements.statement: The system shall detect repeated failed authentication.

acceptance_criteria.given: system receives a sequence of failed authentication attempts from the same IP address
acceptance_criteria.then: the condition is identified and marked as anomalous in the monitoring state
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

unresolved_decisions: What conditions define repeated authentication failures?

requirements.title: detect suspicious process activity
requirements.statement: The system shall detect suspicious process activity.

acceptance_criteria.given: system observes a process executing with unexpected privileges or command sequence
acceptance_criteria.then: the condition is identified and marked as anomalous in the monitoring state
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

unresolved_decisions: What conditions define suspicious process activity?

requirements.title: detect unauthorized configuration changes
requirements.statement: The system shall detect unauthorized configuration changes.

acceptance_criteria.given: system detects a configuration change initiated by an unauthorized entity
acceptance_criteria.then: the condition is identified and marked as anomalous in the monitoring state
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

unresolved_decisions: What makes a configuration change unauthorized?

requirements.title: allow Security administrators to review alerts
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Security administrators to review alerts.

acceptance_criteria.given: Security administrators request alerts by name
acceptance_criteria.then: the requested alerts are returned for examination; an external test capture records the resulting response
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: allow Security administrators to investigate affected devices
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Security administrators to investigate affected devices.

acceptance_criteria.given: Security administrators initiate an investigation on affected devices
acceptance_criteria.when: the operation 'investigate affected devices' is performed
acceptance_criteria.then: the device status and relevant data are made available for analysis; an external test capture records the resulting state
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: allow Security administrators to record investigation notes
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Security administrators to record investigation notes.

acceptance_criteria.given: Security administrators prepare to document findings
acceptance_criteria.when: the operation 'record investigation notes' is initiated
acceptance_criteria.then: the notes are stored in the system; an external test capture records the inspection record
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the inspection record

requirements.title: allow Security administrators to change alert status
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Security administrators to change alert status.

acceptance_criteria.given: Security administrators update alert status for a specific alert
acceptance_criteria.when: the operation 'change alert status' is performed
acceptance_criteria.then: the alert status is updated in the system; an external test capture records the resulting response
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: allow Security administrators to isolate compromised endpoints when necessary
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Security administrators to isolate compromised endpoints when necessary.

acceptance_criteria.given: Security administrators detect a compromised endpoint
acceptance_criteria.when: the operation 'isolate compromised endpoints when necessary' is executed
acceptance_criteria.then: the endpoint is isolated and access is blocked; an external test capture records the resulting state
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: maintain audit logs of security events and administrator actions
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain audit logs of security events and administrator actions.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system maintains audit logs of security events and administrator actions
acceptance_criteria.when: an administrator performs a privileged action or a security event occurs
acceptance_criteria.then: audit logs are held in a secure, immutable storage mechanism and accessible to authorized personnel upon request
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

unresolved_decisions: Which fields must the audit logs contain?
What retention period is required for the audit logs?

requirements.title: provide a centralized dashboard for monitoring security status across multiple campus locations
requirements.statement: The system shall provide a centralized dashboard for monitoring security status across multiple campus locations.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system provides a centralized dashboard for monitoring security status across multiple campus locations
acceptance_criteria.when: a security event is detected or administrator updates configuration
acceptance_criteria.then: the centralized dashboard displays security status across campus locations, updated after each configuration change or event detection
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

nonfunctional.applicability_reason: Independent source obligations; unspecified choices remain TBD.

requirements.title: be secure

acceptance_criteria.given: A draft acceptance plan for this quality goal: the system shall be secure against unauthorized access and data exfiltration via network monitoring channels.
acceptance_criteria.when: An analyst inspects or reviews that acceptance plan to determine whether it includes measurable targets for detecting, logging, and responding to anomalous data
acceptance_criteria.then: The plan's measurable targets remain TBD or unconfirmed; no specific thresholds, detection methods, or response timelines are defined in the current draft.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the inspection record

unresolved_decisions: Which security acceptance outcomes must be demonstrated?

glossary.summary: Source-present terminology; definitions introduce no additional product obligation.

items.title: Device isolation
items.detail: Restriction of a device's network access; the source determines whether and by whom this action is permitted.

items.title: Log
items.detail: A collection of event records. This term does not itself require additional logging fields, events or access permissions.

items.title: Audit record
items.detail: A stored record of an event. Required event scope and retention are determined by the linked source, not this definition.

sdlc.justification: No differentiating input evidence is provided to favor one SDLC model over others. All models receive equal suitability scores (40/100) because the decision factors are missing or unranked. The absence of explicit requirements about budget, delivery, failure consequences, feedback, legacy systems, regulation, schedule, stability, uncertainty, verification, or assurance levels prevents meaningful differentiation between lifecycle approaches.
tradeoffs: Recurring delivery requires stakeholder review and backlog refinement; a cycle does not guarantee completeness or remove unresolved decisions.
